judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Blazor CRUD components
judgeRationales.rationale: Both deliver a buildable Employee CRUD implementation with an Employee DbContext, but B follows the key migration requirement and demonstrates a real schema migration with the employee/department foreign key. A's EnsureCreated-based startup setup is a material requirement mismatch.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold MVC CRUD with an existing DbContext
judgeRationales.rationale: Both appear to satisfy the task fully. B provides slightly stronger evidence of the parent-first navigation workflow and a cleaner build-validation sequence; the difference is modest.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Minimal API child and required parent CRUD
judgeRationales.rationale: Both responses substantially fulfill the requested scaffold and are close in quality. B has stronger evidence of an end-to-end working result, including runtime CRUD verification and an actually applied migration; A is clearer on the dynamic .http ID handoff. The difference is modest.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Minimal API endpoints with OpenAPI
judgeRationales.rationale: Both produce a compiling SQLite-backed CRUD API, but B fulfills all additional deliverables: a CRUD .http file, actual EF migrations rather than EnsureCreated, and rich OpenAPI metadata. It also validates the endpoint behavior.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Razor Pages CRUD with EF Core and SQLite
judgeRationales.rationale: B satisfies every requested area, including the important Category-management dependency and an actual applied EF migration, with successful restore/build validation. A has Product CRUD and context wiring but omits Category CRUD and leaves migration/database setup unfinished.
